facts.text: Andrew expressed hope for forming a strong bond with Toby.

evidence.quote: That's amazing. You have such a strong bond with them! I hope I can have such a strong bond with Toby as well.
They mean the world to me. I'm so lucky to have them. I sure with your love, you and Toby can have a strong bond.

facts.text: Audrey encouraged Andrew to take time to form a bond with Toby.

evidence.quote: Remember, it takes time to form a bond, don't rush!

facts.text: Andrew stated he would attempt to care for Toby independently before seeking help.

evidence.quote: I'll try figure it on my own first. Appreciate the help!

facts.text: Audrey offered assistance to Andrew in caring for Toby.

evidence.quote: Let me know if you need some tips on taking care of Toby.
